S.FORM: == Zaid Abdul-Aziz == sukay niza Amilika a tademaw, tatama, nalecuhan i 4 a bulad 7 a demiad, 1946 a mihcan. ngangan niza ci Zaid Abdul-Aziz, u miunduay ciniza. u kanas-mali mimaliay.
